status: Image-based layout estimate. Not measured CAD or confirmed fit.

sources.review: All seven gallery images, listing features and specification rows. Black/aluminum listing;160mm item diameter is rotor diameter, not caliper size. No body dimensions. Included-components row conflicts with mechanical kit description and is not used.
Mechanical brake, organic pads, MTB/hybrid, IS/PM, two160mm rotors and mounting brackets. No caliper dimension drawing.
Multiple fitted and disassembled views, cable arm, rear adjuster, washer stack and35/40mm caliper bolts.
A2 front160/rear140 versus A3 front180/rear160. M6×18 bracket bolt references. Offset geometry not dimensioned.
IS51, PM74.17 standards. Not a Clarks casting drawing.

method.description: Manual visual reconstruction using multiple photographs and standard interfaces. Not photogrammetry or a scan. Perspective and edited marketing image scales are uncontrolled.

same_panel_scale_check.limitations: Manual endpoints, shank/head boundary and photo perspective uncertain. Used only to select a roughly110mm layout envelope; not hole-location metrology.

method.axial_depth: Least constrained. Selected60mm with a broad45–75mm planning range from oblique/fitted views; no defensible direct axial scale.

uncertainty_note: Ranges are engineering allowances, not measured tolerance bounds or statistical confidence intervals. Real hardware can fall outside them.

assumptions.mounting_pose: PM axes radial; IS axes shaft-parallel. Exact bracket offset and axial pose are inferred, unverified.
assumptions.rear_pad_adjuster_and_arm: Included in body envelope; tool clearance is additional.
assumptions.internal_mechanism: Not modeled; no working spring, pad mechanism, bearing or thread designs.

excluded: No brake force, speed, heat-duty or motor cooling validation.
